0.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_000
0.description: Welcome to Namai. Is there anything you wish to know about our village?

1.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_001
1.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, lovely to see you again. Is there anything you wish to know about our village?

4.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_A1_000_002
4.description: What kind of place is this?

6.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_010
6.description: My name is Nanohana. I have lived here my entire life.

7.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_011
7.description: It may not be the liveliest of places, but our supply of clean water allows us to produce some of the realm's finest rice.

8.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_020
8.description: Namai's entire economy is based on the growing and selling of rice.

9.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_021
9.description: “Namai” is actually a local term for an arrowhead, a weed that can often be found growing in paddy fields.

10.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_022
10.description: It has been hard seeing so many of my friends taken away by the Empire, but I cling to the hope that they are still doing well.

11.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_023
11.description: It was tough to accept that the Empire had taken away so many of my friends, but it is high time I stopped moping and took action. Namai shall unite to help take back Doma!

12.name: TEXT_REGOTH3NAMAI_00412_NANOHANA_000_024
12.description: We could not have reclaimed our homeland without your help, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We shall be in your debt as long as we live.
